Controller Update. Fuel. V1.2.0.0
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/b11555a7f7c8027da316ef918d9e31fd30298c52.png

Controller jump and crouch keys remapped. Grenade launcher is easier to use now with the right stick while aiming, especially when battling turrets.
If all fuel used, fuel regeneration rate increases tremendously until its below 50%. No more waiting for enough fuel for double jump!

[olist]
 Jump by pressing Left Analog Stick;
 Grenade - press Right Analog Stick instead of Y;
 Crouch - Left Shoulder Button
 Increased fuel regeneration speed four times while fuel is below 50%.
[/olist]

Orange Moon Steam overlay V0.0.6.2 update
notes.notes:
Steam overlay is now available in Orange Moon, along with all features it provides. The game will also have minimum 33 achievements closer to full release.

Orange Moon V0.0.6.2:

Steam overlay;
Fixed bug when game couldn't be loaded from the beginning of the level before save point reached. Thank you cmmcnair1  for submitting this bug.

Note:
There is  bug when steam overlay doesn't show up in the main menu, or if showed up, cannot be closed with shift+tab. If the latter occurred, alt+tab the game and overlay will disappear. This happens only in the main menu and I am working on this issue.

Orange Moon V0.0.6.0 update
Second after Recycler Orange Moon boss is coming to Orange Moon in the upcoming level 7 update.
notes.notes:
Made out of Orange Moon lifeforms, human and mechanical parts, this abomination lays toxic smoke bombs and spits acid. Upon approach it spawns highly flammable toxic clouds around itself as a protection from predators. It is slow and clumsy, obviously an experiment gone wrong.  Uses pair of augmented human hands to drag its huge body around.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/d817973e61ab2ae12ca86c22ad70b23c8376ca5c.png

Quantity on the moon - unknown.

Who is to blame for their existence - raiders, aliens or Moon Resources Corp.?

Moon abomination encountered on 7th level of Orange Moon - “Excavations”.
